howSelection.title: How selection works
howSelection.heading: How selection works
howSelection.intro: One person each day, chosen at random from everyone eligible. Here is exactly how, with nothing left out.
howSelection.poolBody: Two days before each cycle, at midnight UTC, we freeze a list of everyone eligible. Eligible means: an active account, at least {{age}} years old, community rules accepted, verified as a real person, and choosing to take part. That is the whole list. Becoming eligible one minute after the freeze means waiting for the next day — which is what makes the draw reproducible.
howSelection.drawBody: We record a hash of the frozen list and a cryptographically secure random seed, then rank every candidate by an HMAC of their identifier under that seed. The first is chosen; the next {{backups}} are backups. Everyone in the list has exactly the same chance.
howSelection.acceptBody: The chosen person is told they were selected and has {{hours}} hours to answer. If they decline or do not answer, we ask the first backup, then the second, then the third. Declining and silence are treated the same way: nothing happens, and the person stays in every future draw.
howSelection.onceBody: Anyone who has been Today’s Human is removed from every future draw. There is no cooldown and no second turn. One human, one day, forever.
howSelection.verifyBody: After a cycle goes live we publish the pool hash and the seed. Anyone can recompute the ordering from them and confirm the person we published is the person the draw chose. The functions that do it are open to everyone, signed in or not.
howSelection.neverPay: Paying us anything. There is no way to buy a better chance, and there never will be.
howSelection.neverFollowers: Follower counts. Nobody has followers here — the product has no such thing.
howSelection.neverBoost: Boosts, promotions or featured slots. None exist.
howSelection.neverSponsor: Sponsors. No sponsor can influence who appears.
howSelection.neverInfluencer: Being already famous. Existing fame is not an input to anything here.
howSelection.neverAlgorithm: Engagement, activity, or how interesting we think you are.
howSelection.safetyBody: Suspended and banned accounts are not in the pool, and a portrait is reviewed by a person before it is published. If a cycle cannot be filled in time, we publish nothing and say so rather than publishing someone unreviewed.
howSelection.footer: These rules come from our Product Constitution. The parts about fairness cannot be amended.
